parameters.gold: σ Daily transition rate E1→E2 and E2→I1 (two-stage latent period)
parameters.extracted: σ Daily rate of transition E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁; implies average incubation period d_L = 2*(1/σ) days.

parameters.gold: γ Daily transition rate I1→I2 and I2→R (two-stage infectious period)
parameters.extracted: γ Daily rate of transition I₁→I₂ and I₂→R; implies average infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ) days.

parameters: β Constant transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in force of infection λ(t) proportional to infectious people.
λ(t) Force of infection (rate at which a susceptible becomes infected), assumed proportional to number of infectious people at time t and transmission rate β (homogeneous mixing).
π Initial susceptibility (proportion non-immune at start); used in effective reproduction number R_n together with epidemic growth rate parameter ψ.
λ₀ Initial infection rate / initial force of infection parameter at epidemic start (as used in parameter set Θ_T = (π, λ₀, ψ, σ, γ)).
ψ Epidemic growth-related parameter (EGR parametrisation); used with π to determine effective reproduction number R_n.
p_ICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection.
μ_ICU|E Mean of Gamma-distributed waiting time from infection to ICU/HDU admission.
σ²_ICU|E Variance of Gamma-distributed waiting time from infection to ICU/HDU admission.
η Negative Binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts (observation model).
R₀ Basic reproduction number; discussed with plausible range 1≤R₀≤4 used to set priors (no explicit formula given in provided sections).
R_n Effective reproduction number in partially immune population; stated to be a function of susceptibility π and EGR parameter ψ (explicit formula not provided in provided sections).
TAR Total Attack Rate: probability of being infected over the whole epidemic for a susceptible individual (computed from transmission model; explicit formula not provided in provided sections).
β Transmission rate in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N (homogeneous mixing)

observations: Missed 1 compartment(s), 6 flow(s), 1 parameter(s) from gold standard.
Hallucinated 1 compartment(s), 5 flow(s), 12 parameter(s) not in gold standard.
